items.text: Nico Collins listed OUT for Week 3. Confirmed via Schefter/Rapoport hamstring.
items.implication: Schultz elevated target share (28-30% routes last week without him).
items.opportunity: Dalton Schultz high TE usage/target share vs IND.

items.text: Commanders officially ruled out QB Jayden Daniels for Sunday. Not IR; positive week-to-week notes from Rapoport/Peters no surgery.
items.why: Left elbow dislocation; no surgery planned.
items.implication: Marcus Mariota starts; McLaurin still viable but lower total.
items.opportunity: Commanders pass catchers with Mariota (McLaurin 25% share historically).

items.text: Broncos: JK Dobbins and RJ Harvey off injury report, good to go vs Rams. Jonah Coleman OUT (ankle).
items.implication: Committee with Dobbins/Harvey healthy; reverse Coleman beneficiary.

items.text: Steelers ruled out RB Rico Dowdle (toe) vs Bengals. Jaylen Warren questionable (shoulder) but coach says he will lead.
items.implication: Warren lead back + checkdowns; Homer/Heidenreich backups.
items.opportunity: Jaylen Warren lead + high checkdown volume from Rodgers.
items.conflict: Warren Q shoulder but expected to play/lead.

items.text: Puka Nacua doubtful (hip); McVay says barring setback could return next week vs Eagles. Did not practice Friday.
items.implication: Adams elevated targets; return Week 4 expected.
items.opportunity: Davante Adams target share bump sans Nacua.

items.text: Malik Nabers and Travis Etienne listed IN (full/expected). Darnold, Dobbins, Harvey, Kyler also IN.
items.why: ETR Sunday list; Nabers full practice notes.
items.implication: Nabers full role; Etienne committee but active.

items.text: Brock Bowers, Zay Flowers, Mike Evans QUESTIONABLE. Warren/Pittman also Q.
items.opportunity: If Flowers OUT, Ravens WR depth; Bowers debut upside if IN.

items.text: Jahmyr Gibbs set new ETR record ceiling projection at 44.0 (top 25th %ile sim avg) for Week 3 slate. Projections live.
items.why: Sim ceiling highest ever in their model.
items.implication: Elite upside play; base also strong historically like CMC comps.
items.opportunity: High snap/route/carry ceiling in Lions offense.

items.text: With Dowdle OUT, Jaylen Warren will lead the Steelers RB group per coach; expect zillion checkdowns as vertical not working for Rodgers. Homer/Heidenreich backups.
items.why: Coach quote + Dowdle toe OUT; Rodgers checkdown lean.
items.conflict: Warren shoulder Q but coach plans lead.

items.text: Packers first game sans Jayden Reed: Watson 45 routes, Golden 44 on 55 Love dropbacks. Watson+Golden 48% targets so far.
items.implication: Clear WR1/2 route volume for Watson.
items.opportunity: High routes + red-zone share continuation vs ATL.

items.text: Jonathon Brooks expected IR (5 games total career); Chuba Hubbard firmly lead (RB14 util), AJ Dillon primary backup (Etienne also IR).
items.implication: Hubbard clear lead back ROS short-term.

items.text: Loves: Derrick Henry (vs DAL soft run D, high prop), Chase Brown (20+ touches/15% tgt, PIT soft), Chris Olave (double-digit tgts, LV soft), Christian Watson (util WR8, RZ), Dalton Schultz (28% tgt sans Collins, IND soft TE).
items.implication: Strong starts; Schultz boosted by Collins OUT.

items.text: Hates: Rhamondre Stevenson (low snaps post-fumble, tough JAX), Travis Etienne (low touch/snap share even w/ Kamara), Terry McLaurin (SEA tough WR D, low total), Rome Odunze (low tgt share, PHI tough).
items.implication: Sit/fade; Henderson rising but Stevenson still ranked ahead by Berry.
items.conflict: Berry still ranks Stevenson > Henderson short-term.

items.text: Kyle Pitts only 63% routes, 6 targets/8% share through games. TPRR 33% London off vs 17% on. Long-time fade.
items.why: Route % and target share data; London dependency.
items.implication: Hard to trust Pitts even in good spots.
items.opportunity: London dominates when on; Pitts limited.
